hero.ability1: Prelude to Madness: At the End of your Turn, you may send a Minion from your Deck or Graveyard to your Void.
hero.ability2: A dream of ruin stirs the deep. : At the End of your Turn, Summon Minions from your Void with a combined Cost of 1 or less.
hero.ability3: The abyss rends the world open. : The total Cost of Minions you may Summon from your Void at the End of your Turn increases by 2 for every 10 Health your Hero is below its starting Health.
hero.ability4: Time collapses, the sleeper awakens. : Once per game, if your Hero would be reduced to 0 Health, instead set your Hero’s current and maximum Health to 5. Then Summon a Minion with a Cost of 10 or less from your Void.
